questions.text: What stood out to you from the message (East or West)?
In your own words, give a definition of wisdom.
subquestions: Using the text, what are the different sources of wisdom?
Outside of wisdom from God, by what other things are we influenced, believing it to be wisdom?

questions.text: How does the passage show us the contrast between wisdom that comes from God and wisdom that comes from another source?
Verse 13 says “...by his good conduct let him show his works in the meekness of wisdom”.
subquestions: What does “meekness of wisdom” mean? Why is it critical in our attitude toward restoring relationships?

questions.text: According to James 1:5 how do we gain wisdom?
subquestions: How does the life of Jesus exemplify God’s wisdom? (James 3:17).
In what ways can we follow Jesus' example of wisdom in relation to our own relationships considering verse 18?
